title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Israel's Violations of Lebanese Sovereignty
detail: Saudi Arabia formally rejected what it called Israel's violation of Lebanese sovereignty, issuing a public condemnation of Israeli military operations in Lebanon. The statement marks a significant diplomatic signal as Riyadh positions itself as a defender of Arab state sovereignty amid ongoing regional tensions.

media.caption: Saudi Arabia issues formal condemnation of Israeli operations in Lebanon

title: Trump Demands Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Qatar Join Abraham Accords as Iran Deal Condition
detail: President Trump issued an ultimatum demanding that Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Qatar immediately join the Abraham Accords, linking the demand to any Iran nuclear deal. The move complicated ongoing diplomacy as the UAE is already a member of the Accords. Saudi Arabia's public rejection of normalization with Israel without a Palestinian state solution puts it at odds with the Trump demand, while privately MBS has reportedly signaled readiness to normalize.

media.caption: Trump links Abraham Accords membership to Iran nuclear deal for Gulf states
